thread:
emily_cs: Quick help - customer (NimbusCo) saw intermittent 403s during desktop onboarding. CI and server tests are fine, but their Electron app tests fail.

emily_cs: They pasted this minimal repro (token scrubbed):
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABCDEF" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-small","input":"ping"}'
```

emily_cs: When run from their terminal with default curl (http2 enabled on their box) they sometimes get 403 JSON: `{"error":"invalid_auth","message":"token missing or invalid for this route"}`

emily_cs: If they force HTTP/1.1 (`curl --http1.1 -v ...`) same token + payload returns 200.

raj_engineer: interesting. do we have the request-id header from the 403 responses? ask them to copy the full response headers.

emily_cs: sent back two ids: req_bd21 and req_bd22. Both 403 with same message. They also said Electron uses a node http2 client via a library shim.

holt_net: sounds like an enterprise proxy is trimming Authorization when handling HTTP/2 frames. common with older proxies that terminate h2 and re-emit to backend.

raj_engineer: agree. two onboarding workarounds: 1) set Electron client to use HTTP/1.1; 2) have infra update proxy to passthrough `authorization`. For us, we can patch node SDK with a `preferHttp1` flag to force http1.1 and emit `X-Auth-Hint: 1` as an aid.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: eng-runtime/sdk-http1-toggle #1210 -> staging 2025-12-02T14:00:00Z

emily_cs: customer accepted the HTTP/1.1 workaround and completed the end-to-end checks. requested a short KB entry and a note in the onboarding checklist.

holt_net: follow-ups for CS: include curl repro steps (`--http2` vs `--http1.1`) in KB, recommend ramped concurrency if they re-enable http2 (multiplexing may make failures intermittent), and advise infra to allow `authorization` passthrough.

emily_cs: I'll log a low renewal-risk note (they paused 48 hours during triage) and schedule a 30-min enablement call to walk them through production settings.

raj_engineer: filed the tiny SDK ticket + unit test. also added guidance to prevent aggressive retry loops that caused a few 429s while they retried the 403s.

emily_cs: thanks all — attaching the transcript and curl steps to the support ticket and closing when KB lands. :thumbsup:

holt_net: added KB draft to the infra wiki.
